name: Kenilworth Summer Camp
description_short: Borough recreation day camp at Harding Elementary School in Kenilworth for children entering grades 1 to 7, with structured morning activities such as STEAM, sports, crafts and team building and camper's choice in the afternoon. Five day or three day weeks, with after care at the Rec Center.

fees.name: After care (3 to 6 pm, Rec Center)
fees.note: Non-resident rate for 5 days; $48 for 3 days. Residents $40 (5 days) or $24 (3 days).

refund_policy_summary: Full refund less a $10 administrative fee if withdrawal notice is given at least 5 days before the start of the program or week.
notes: Non-resident rate $160 per week for 5 days ($100 for 3 days); Kenilworth residents $85 per week ($55 for 3 days). Camp 9 am to 3 pm, drop off from 8 am if needed; no camp Friday July 3. Registration is for the summer, not week by week; payment plan of 50 percent at registration and the rest by June 20. Campers bring lunch Monday to Thursday; on Fridays the Rec supplies lunch and ice pops. Session price is the weekly rate.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 camp page. Ages derived from grades 1 to 7. Harding School has no street address on the page; ZIP is from the Borough Hall address in the page footer (567 Boulevard, Kenilworth, NJ 07033)
